name: NukeBrowser
subtitle: Photos-style browser for remote media
localizedDescription: A media browser for remote file servers. It opens WebDAV remotes, HTTP directory indexes and rclone remotes that hold tens of thousands of images and videos in nested folders: instant thumbnails from a persisted index, pinch-to-resize columns, a full-screen viewer, slideshow, and a metadata panel for AI-generated images. Read-only: it never uploads, renames or deletes anything on a remote. Requires iOS 27.
